top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology is an original, independently confirmed discovery chain (proglucagon processing, the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, its insulinotropic action in humans) with mature, trial-documented consequences for type 2 diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The Holst, Drucker and Mojsov allocation credits discovery rather than drug engineering and fits the three-person limit, though Mojsov's priority and the omission of Knudsen remain defensible points of contention. No award is clearly worse than this award.
